title: EffectOnConditionDef
description:
An effect_on_condition definition from JSON type `"effect_on_condition"`.

EOCs are scripts that run when certain conditions are met. They can be used for ambient effects, quest triggers, timed events, and more.

abstract_.description: Abstract flag — if true, this definition is a template.

condition.description: Condition that must be true for the effect to run.

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

effect.description: The effect(s) to execute when triggered. Can be a single effect object or an array of effect objects.

false_effect.description: Effect(s) to run when the condition is false.

global.description: Whether this EOC runs globally (affects all NPCs).

npcs.description: List of NPC IDs this EOC applies to.

recurrence.description: Recurrence interval — can be a number (turns), a time string ("1 hours"), a range ["1 hours", "2 hours"], or a complex object.

required_event.description: Event type required to trigger this EOC (for "EVENT" type).

run_for_npcs.description: Whether this EOC should run for NPCs.
